storyCards.headline: Roxanne: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Police's "Roxanne" reached #32 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #32 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 13 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "Every Breath You Take-The Singles" (1986) — not the song's original release year.

Album: Every Breath You Take-The Singles (1986).
